name: uav-parts
description: Find, compare and source drone parts from an evidence-graded catalogue: requirements search, drop-in alternatives, build and BOM checks, country of origin and makers' NDAA, Blue UAS, ITAR and export statements. Invite-only: asks for your personal access key.
